queries: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), ranked AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, 1.0 * account_count / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY account_count DESC) AS place FROM district_counts) SELECT district_id, account_count, share FROM ranked WHERE place <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, district_id;
